lesson_topic: The discriminant and the quadratic formula — nature of roots
title: Quadratic formula (proof)
transcript_key_points: Deriving the quadratic formula by completing the square
Discriminant D = b² − 4ac decides the nature of roots
D > 0: two distinct real roots; D = 0: equal roots; D < 0: no real roots

lesson_topic: Sum and product of roots (−b/a, c/a); forming equations from roots
title: Relation between roots and coefficients | Quadratic Equations
transcript_key_points: Sum of roots α + β = −b/a; product αβ = c/a
Watch the sign: the sum formula has a minus sign
Form an equation from roots: x² − (sum)x + product = 0
